description: Capture the current Android accessibility hierarchy and cache short-lived elementRefs. By default, saves the raw hierarchy and complete parsed element tree to .androidmcp-framework/artifacts/snapshots/ and returns a compact summary to avoid filling the agent context. Set includeElements=true to return the elements inline.

includeElements.description: Include element objects in the MCP response; default false to keep large trees out of context.

interactiveOnly.description: Default true: cache only clickable/focusable/scrollable/checkable elements or elements with text/content descriptions. false caches the full parsed tree.

persist.description: Persist raw hierarchy XML and the full parsed tree to a JSON artifact (default true).

projectPath.description: Project root; auto-discovers the nearest framework config or Git root when omitted.

name: snapshot_ui
title: Snapshot UI
